title: Adoption
definition: Adoption is God’s gracious act of receiving believers as His children through Jesus Christ, giving them the privileges, security, and inheritance of sons and daughters.
summary: In adoption, believers are not only forgiven criminals; they are welcomed children. They receive the Spirit of adoption and cry, “Abba, Father.”
christFocus: Christ brings us into the Father’s family. Through Him, believers receive belonging, love, discipline, inheritance, and access to God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Adoption rests on union with Christ, the Son.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Adoption gives access, identity, inheritance, and assurance.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The Spirit bears witness that believers belong to God.
